name: hauler
note: Large-file transfer. Многогигабайтные загрузки/выгрузки — нормальный профиль, маскирует крупный симметричный трафик.
page_description: Send files up to 200GB. Resumable, encrypted, no account needed.

hero.headline: Move big files without the drama
hero.subhead: Drag, drop, share a link. Resumable transfers that survive flaky wifi and don't care how large your export is.

features.title: Built for files that don't fit anywhere else
features.feat_1_body: Lost connection at 87%? We pick up exactly where the last chunk landed.
features.feat_2_body: Files are sealed in your browser before a single byte leaves. We can't read them.
features.feat_3_body: Uploads hit the nearest of 40 regions, so a 60GB push isn't a coffee break.

cta.headline: Stop zipping things into Google Drive
cta.subhead: Send your first haul in under a minute.

footer.tagline: The dumb-simple way to move files that are too big to email.
footer.built_with: Shipped from a garage in Lisbon 🛠️
